links.title: PPE Detection
links.tooltip: Ver alertas y predicciones de PPE

panels.title: Conectividad
panels.description: Indica si el dispositivo está enviando datos. Se considera OFFLINE si no envía métricas en los últimos 2 minutos.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Porcentaje de uso de CPU actual.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "edge-data")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_metrics" and r._field == "cpu_percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.camera_id == "${camera_id}")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "cpu")

panels.title: CPU (%)
panels.description: Historial de uso de CPU del dispositivo.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "edge-data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_metrics" and r._field == "cpu_percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.camera_id == "${camera_id}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "cpu")

panels.title: Tráfico de Red (TX / RX)
panels.description: Velocidad de transmisión y recepción de datos de red.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "edge-data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "net_bytes_tx" or r._field == "net_bytes_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.camera_id == "${camera_id}")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> yield(name: "network")
